plates.title: Current design (2026)
plates.fact: Quintana Roo's 2026 plate is a minimalist white design framed in maroon (guinda) with the Quintana Roo logo at the top.

notes: The Canje de Placas 2026 began Jan 2, 2026 (sefiplan.qroo.gob.mx/site/contenido/211). Plates are valid for 3 years, so the 2023 design (white with a turquoise Caribbean scene and green 'Quintana Roo' script) is being replaced. The tenencia subsidy ran to Mar 31, 2026. I found no hard end date for 2023 plates, so that design is not listed. The official pages (sefiplan, cgc.qroo.gob.mx, satq.qroo.gob.mx) only have REC and 'Ponte las placas' banners, with no plate artwork. No specialty plates found.
